Card Q&A.a: No. This effect can’t ignore digivolution requirements. When activating this effect, you can only digivolve into a card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits if it also meets the digivolution requirements.
Card Q&A.q: If I have cards in my trash with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in their traits, does this card's inherited effect let me digivolve any card into any of them, regardless of digivolution requirements?

Card Q&A.a: No. The [When Attacking] effect wasn't present when you declared the attack, so it doesn't activate.
Card Q&A.q: I activate this card’s inherited effect to digivolve into a card with a [When Attacking] effect. Does that effect activate immediately?

Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits from your trash for its digivolution cost.
